headline: Toktogul District Official Held Over 4,500-Som Demand; Herding Family Reported It
dek: The Public Integrity Commission and the Ministry of Internal Security's Toktogul detachment say a land and pasture specialist took marked notes from a family from Ozgörüsh.
ticker: Toktogul official held over bribe; herding family from Ozgörüsh reported him
paragraphs: The Public Integrity Commission and the Ministry of Internal Security's Toktogul detachment announced on Sunday that a 47-year-old official of the Toktogul District administration was detained on Friday in Toktogul town on suspicion of taking a bribe.

The suspect, K.T., born 1979 and a Toktogul resident, is a senior specialist in the administration's land and pasture section. A herding family from Ozgörüsh, on the tribal side in the Chatkal Highlands, told investigators he asked 4,500 som to register their winter herd crossing of State Route 1 and to release their hay allocation. He was held after accepting 3,000 som in marked notes as a first instalment.

He is charged with taking a bribe under the Criminal Code, and the file has gone to the Attorney General's office. He has been released on a written undertaking not to leave the district while the inquiry continues.

The Commission said the family came forward on their own and that no other staff are yet suspected. "A family that could have paid and said nothing came to us instead, and the case was moved to the Attorney General within days," said Commission chair Gulzat Bekmuratova.
District head Bakytbek Turdumatov said the section's remaining staff are cooperating with investigators and that herders' paperwork is being handled as usual.
